entries.note: Read only the authenticated image response, with the same 8 MiB, 8192-per-axis and 16-megapixel bounds as the service. The pinned stb decoder enables PNG/JPEG/GIF only and displays the first frame. A successful metadata read is insufficient: full decoding must succeed. WebP is explicitly unavailable; SVG remains on the text path. Clear previous pixels before any refresh, retain only one CPU buffer until texture upload, and stop retrying a failed upload until Refresh.

The native main thread owns the decoded buffer and backend-neutral texture. Clear and close are safe before upload and after it; successful upload frees CPU pixels. App response generations reject stale reads after refresh/detach. Detach releases pixels while retaining fit preference; reopening reloads the root/path. Hidden restored image tabs stay undecoded until opened.
